title: Fix Puzzle Plugin AppLabelsOverlay Missing Fields
description: bun run dev:puzzle:3d fails: puzzle-plugin fails to compile because two AppLabelsOverlay struct literals in puzzle/plugin/rs/lib.rs (Puzzle2dPlayApp::app_labels and Puzzle5dPlayApp::app_labels) are missing the newly added action_labels/utility_labels fields from semio_framework_core::AppLabelsOverlay. Add the missing fields (empty HashMaps) to match the pattern used in flow/plugin and cad/plugin, then verify the puzzle plugin build succeeds.
summary: Verified the puzzle-plugin AppLabelsOverlay fix (action_labels/utility_labels HashMaps added to Puzzle2dPlayApp and Puzzle5dPlayApp app_labels literals) resolves the `bun run dev:puzzle:3d` compile failure. Confirmed with `cargo build -p puzzle-plugin --target wasm32-wasip2 --release` (clean build, only pre-existing warnings) and by running the dev server end to end: loaded the Puzzle 3D window, selected the "Concrete Forest" procedural example, and confirmed the WGPU canvas rendered generated geometry with no console errors.
